'''''Agave chrysantha''''', the '''golden-flowered century plant''', is a plant species [[endemic]] to [[Arizona]]. The species is distinguished by its bright yellow flowers, born on a flowering stalk up to 7 m (21 feet) tall.<ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=242101302 Flora of North America v 26 p 429.]</ref><ref>Peebles, Robert Hibbs.  Proceedings of the Biological Society of Washington 48(26): 139–140. 1935.</ref>
